title: Structure Pack Duo #36 (임산부 폴카도트·물결 / 일반 비대칭 몬드리안·매끈 | 공작눈무늬+스테인드글라스+드래곤비늘+뱀비늘 / 금박+코이비늘+스테인드글라스+뱀비늘)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, each from a different look, each with her own multi-material blended body.

#1: Japanese, in her early 20s, bold and confident expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. Both her bust and her hips are simultaneously, dramatically enormous — a colossal heavy bust resting full and wide, and enormous round hips flaring just as dramatically wide below — and between them, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects forward, her waistline already soft and gently defined even without the pregnancy, now continuing that same soft fullness into the belly's round curve with no harsh transition anywhere. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, fair porcelain skin, soft pink blush across the cheeks, sparkling pink eyeshadow, long curled lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy candy-pink lips, a sweet princess-like smile, natural soft black hair styled in curly, real pores, real living eyes, 200 studs piercings set with a mix of diamonds, pearls and sapphires in brass-toned metal, wearing seven to ten pieces, heavily stacked of mixed-metal a bracelet. Fused with 4 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is covered mainly by one background material, with 3 large round patches of other materials scattered irregularly across it, each patch roughly 28% of her figure's width across. Region 1 is the background: everything outside the round patches: it carries peacock feather-eye markings (overlapping feather-barb ridges each converging into a round eye-marking with a raised rim), BLAZING ELECTRIC TEAL-GOLD eye-marking centres, VIVID DEEP VIOLET radiating barb-ridge detail, every marking standing in true relief. Region 2 is the round patch centred about 50% of the way down her figure from the top and about 43% of the way across her figure from her left edge: it carries solid thick stained glass fused to her form, hundreds of small individual panes each no larger than a coin, BLAZING ELECTRIC EMERALD and VIVID GOLD panes alternating in a dense irregular mosaic, dark lead-line seams webbing between every pane. Region 3 is the round patch centred about 26% of the way down her figure from the top and about 20% of the way across her figure from her left edge: it carries dragon scales (large thick armor-plate scales, each one substantial and sharply faceted), BLAZING METALLIC GOLD scale formations, VIVID AMBER scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 4 is the round patch centred about 28% of the way down her figure from the top and about 71% of the way across her figure from her left edge: it carries snake scales (diamond-shaped angular scales aligned in neat overlapping rows), BLAZING PALE GOLD scale formations, VIVID IVORY WHITE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Where a patch meets the background, the two materials interlock naturally: elements of one reach into the other and the two materials simply touch, so the edge of every patch is made only of the patch's material and the background material, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each patch edge follows a gently rippled outline rather than a perfect circle. The materials of every region curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: standing frontal, both hands cradling the underside of her belly, chin level, calm commanding presence, her extreme platform thigh-skimming boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

#2: Japanese, in her late 40s, cheerful expression, warm radiant skin tone — an enormous, overwhelmingly muscular woman. Massive thick arms with heavy defined muscle, a broad powerful muscular back, a huge powerful chest, a heavy dense muscular torso and legs, only a soft hint of a waistline. Enormous round hips and colossal thick thighs with muscle visible through a soft layer, thick heavy calves. Not slim, not lean. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, pale porcelain skin, pink-red eyeshadow smudged softly beneath both eyes, a delicate tear-track blush across the cheeks, large dark circle lenses with bright real catchlights, long lashes, glossy pink-red lips, a hollow, dreamy expression, natural soft black hair styled in a layered tousled shag cut, real pores, real living eyes, 8 clicker rings piercings set with opals in gold-toned metal, wearing two to three pieces of mixed-metal a hair ornament. Fused with 4 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 4 irregular rectangular areas by hazy transition zones running both vertically and horizontally. One vertical transition zone runs the full height of her figure about 61% of the way across her figure from her left edge. To her left of it, a horizontal transition zone crosses about 38% of the way down her figure from the top; to her right of it, a different horizontal transition zone crosses about 56% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is the upper area to her left of the vertical zone, above the left horizontal zone: it carries applied ELECTRIC VIOLET leaf, thin irregular metallic sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, VIVID CYAN undertone glinting through the thinnest points. Region 2 is the lower area to her left of the vertical zone, below the left horizontal zone: it carries koi scales (rounded smooth scales with fine visible growth rings, each scale glossy and slightly domed), BLAZING ELECTRIC CRIMSON scale formations, VIVID PEARL WHITE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 3 is the upper area to her right of the vertical zone, above the right horizontal zone: it carries solid thick stained glass fused to her form, hundreds of small individual panes each no larger than a coin, BLAZING ELECTRIC MAGENTA and VIVID SILVER panes alternating in a dense irregular mosaic, dark lead-line seams webbing between every pane. Region 4 is the lower area to her right of the vertical zone, below the right horizontal zone: it carries snake scales (diamond-shaped angular scales aligned in neat overlapping rows), BLAZING DEEP EMERALD scale formations, VIVID JADE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Where two regions meet, the materials interlock naturally: elements of one reach into the other and the two materials simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring materials, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even course. The materials of every region continue in full strength over her whole figure, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: full side profile, one arm reaching forward, her extreme platform square-toe heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle on any of them. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 aspect ratio, 8K.
